shortDescription: Australia's Woodside Energy ASX:WDS on Wednesday narrowed its annual production forecast and posted a 27% rise in its third-quarter revenue on higher oil and gas prices.The country's top independent oil and gas producer now expects annual production at 174 to 181 million barrels of oil equivalent…

children: on Wednesday narrowed its annual production forecast and posted a 27% rise in its third-quarter revenue on higher oil and gas prices.
The country's top independent oil and gas producer now expects annual production at 174 to 181 million barrels of oil equivalent (mmboe), compared with its earlier forecast of 174-185 mmboe.
